articles.summary: Raphael Zagury to Participate in Two Panel Discussions on October 22nd and Deliver a Mainstage Keynote on October 24 in Lugano, Switzerland Twenty One Capital, Inc. (“Twenty One” or “XXI”) (NYSE: XXI), today announced that Chief Executive Officer Raphael Zagury will deliver a mainstage keynote address titled “Twenty One Capital: Building the Bitcoin Operating Company,” at Plan B Forum 2026 which will be webcast. He will also participate in two panel discussions at Bitfinex Securities’ The Future of Capital Markets conference. Both events will be held in Lugano, Switzerland. All times listed are Central European Summer Time (CEST), with U.S. Eastern Time (ET) in parentheses. Bitfinex Securities: The Future of Capital Markets Date: October 22, 2026 Location: LAC Lugano Arte e Cultura, Lugano, Switzerland Panel: “What’s Next for Bitcoin Treasury Companies” Time: 10:05–10:45 a.m. CEST (4:05–4:45 a.m. ET) Panelists: Raphael Zagury, Chief Executive Officer, Twenty One Capital Matt Cole,
